{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-read the data with proper parsing
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Fix revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("Sentinel value -1 in customer_age:", (sales_df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = (sales_df['status'] == 'refunded').sum()
print("Number of refunded orders:", refunded_count)

# Check channel distribution
channel_dist = sales_df['channel'].value_counts()
print("Channel distribution:\n", channel_dist)

# Check customer_segment distribution by channel
segment_channel = pd.crosstab(sales_df['channel'], sales_df['customer_segment'])
print("Customer segment by channel:\n", segment_channel)

# Check conversion rate by channel
conversion_by_channel = sales_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print("Conversion rate by channel:\n", conversion_by_channel)

# Check revenue by channel
revenue_by_channel = sales_df.groupby('channel')['revenue'].sum()
print("Revenue by channel:\n", revenue_by_channel)

# Return key findings
(sentinel_check := (sales_df['customer_age'] == -1).sum(),
 refunded_count,
 channel_dist,
 segment_channel,
 conversion_by_channel,
 revenue_by_channel)"}
